notes: Connected limbs + nastier damage. Elbows, knees, hips and ankles now have smooth rounded joints, and the arms and legs taper (thick up top, slim at the wrist and ankle), so bent limbs curve like a body instead of two blocks hinged together. Faces swell up as they take punches: the lead eye puffs and closes first, then the other, plus a bruised cheek and a fat lip. Blood starts earlier and there's a lot more of it: bigger sprays, cuts over both eyes, a full blood mask late in the fight, dripping and pooling on the canvas, and the gloves of whoever's hitting them come away red.
